Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <9bs81a$amj$1...@taliesin.netcom.net.uk>, Henke
<d98...@stud.hh.se> writes

>Can I kill Charnas on my minion with enviromental damage? (I.e. weather
>control)

"Cannot be damaged by host, but does not stop host from using effects
which would normally damage it. For example, the host can use Body of
Sun, but would not damage Charnas as a result. [RTR 19941109]"

Per [LSJ20010420] (Message-ID: <3AE0281E...@white-wolf.com>),
damage dealt by a strike (in this case, Burst of Sunlight) against the
striking vampire is considered environmental. (Hence, not preventable
by Skin of Steel etc.)

Since Burst of Sunlight operates with the same template as Body of Sun,
we can extrapolate from that that environmental damage against Charnas
cannot be generated by the vampire with Charnas on him.
